stations.title: Ambrose
stations.say: Can the counter use the repair too?

stations.title: main.cpp
stations.text: Everything in one file, usable by no other.

stations.title: Every .cpp file
stations.text: Includes repair.h and gets the same repair.

captions: Ambrose wants the repair in one place that the counter and the bench can both use.
It is stuck in main.cpp, which no other file can include.
You move the struct and the first lines of its functions into a header, their bodies out.
Now any file can include repair.h and get the same repair.
The repair lives in its own files now. Next, a program built from three of them.
